title: The popular version blames poisoned bread. Historians doubt ergot. Dancing for days does not fit it.
description:
Historians doubt ergot. Dancing for days does not fit it. John Waller argues poisoned people would be unlikely to keep dancing for days, and ergot cannot explain outbreaks along the Rhine and Moselle.

Began dancing in a Strasbourg street on 14 July, with no music. Four of the six chronicle accounts name her.

Later accounts say officials built stages and paid musicians. More people joined in. Onlookers read the spectacle as the anger of Saint Vitus. The council then tore the stages down and banned dancing and music.

The often repeated 15 deaths a day rests on later accounts. Contemporary Strasbourg sources do not mention deaths, and historians disagree on whether anyone died.

The favoured explanation today is stress, not poison.

Sources:
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dancing_plague_of_1518: read in full. Established that the episode was in Strasbourg from July to September 1518, that Frau Troffea began dancing on 14 July and is named in four of six chronicle accounts, that between 50 and 400 people were reported dancing, that the claim of up to 15 deaths a day rests on later accounts while contemporary Strasbourg sources do not mention deaths, that historians doubt ergot because poisoned people would be unlikely to dance for days and it does not explain outbreaks along the Rhine and Moselle, and that John Waller favours stress induced mass psychogenic illness.
- https://publicdomainreview.org/essay/the-dancing-plague-of-1518/: read in full. Independently established that Troffea danced in the street outside her home on 14 July without music, that the council first followed physicians and built dance stages in the horse and grain markets, that this backfired because onlookers read it as the anger of Saint Vitus, that the council then tore down the stages and banned dance and music, that ergot restricts blood flow to the limbs and so makes prolonged dancing implausible, and that the 15 deaths a day figure is conditional and the final toll unknown.
